name: Tactical Attack
description:
One unit shoots another, on a turn, at a tile it is allowed to shoot. The pack priced shots before it could take one: cover_bonus_grid computes the modifier, action_point_economy charges for the verb, and grid_movement_range publishes the red tiles -- and combat.melee_basic, the library's only other source of combat.hit, swings in a facing direction from a real-time walker, which is not a thing a unit standing on a tile can do.

It decides only whether the shot LANDS. Legality is grid_movement_range's attackable set, the modifier is cover_bonus_grid's assessment, and the damage is combat.damage_resolver's -- this rolls against a base chance scaled by cover and emits combat.hit or combat.miss accordingly. Splitting it that way is what lets a game change the cover rules, the range rules and the damage rules independently, which is the whole reason those three are separate components.

A miss is announced rather than swallowed, because the wallet charges for the attempt: a free miss turns every turn into a fishing expedition, and a player who sees nothing happen assumes the click was lost.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: baseHitChance
inputs.description: Chance to land with no cover in the way. 0.8 leaves room for cover to matter without making an open-field shot a coin toss.

inputs.name: damage
inputs.description: Damage handed to combat.damage_resolver on a landed shot. The resolver owns what that becomes.

inputs.name: friendlyFire
inputs.description: Whether a unit may target its own side. Off by default, because the usual reason it happens is a misclick.

inputs.name: minHitChance
inputs.description: Floor under the modified chance, so no shot is arithmetically impossible. A 0% shot reads as a broken button rather than a bad idea.

outputs.name: lastShot
outputs.description: Attacker, target, cover tier, final chance, and whether it landed.

outputs.name: shotsTaken
outputs.description: Attempts this battle, landed or not.
